pending-clause.answer: Item b) (byte alignment) matches 14.5.8; §2002:14.5.8 notes a usage-bit item need not sit on a byte boundary, which is exactly what b) then requires of ADDRESS OF, so 2002 means the same as 2023 (refused at 2002, COBOL2786). Item a) matches 8.8.1.x: it bars exponentiation outright, so 8.8.1.3.6 cannot reach it, and the shape requirement (literals only) does not depend on 2002's 32-digit standard intermediate (PB5575); a value difference there is PB5575's, not this rule's. 8.5.3/8.5.4 match on words only. Scope and evidence unchanged.
